title: Validate complete candidates against the closed registered record contract
statement: The Work records Module shall validate complete typed current candidates against closed shapes, identities, support and reference rules before publication, without inferring omitted judgments.

what.problem: A candidate can appear readable while carrying unknown vocabulary, ambiguous identities, incomplete registration, or references that resolve differently for different consumers.
what.desired_outcome: All supported candidate entry paths obtain one structurally admissible final representation or a precise safe rejection.

why.rationale: SR-042 requires closed current-record validity; MOD-011 owns the complete candidate and shared validation responsibility.

stakeholders: Engineers and agents supplying explicit command requests
Maintainers of MOD-011 and its Interface consumers

conditions: An ordinary task or staged maintenance candidate requires current-record validation.

contexts: The shared IF-003 validation boundary for a coherent Change and its typed supporting accounts.

how.approach: Reject malformed closed values before checking exact typed references, attribution and preservation against the complete candidate.

how_much.scope: The current v4 record shapes and dependency rules, separate from REM conformance and engineering adequacy.

acceptance_criteria: Unknown fields or closed-vocabulary values, duplicate keys or identities, missing required values, invalid encodings or versions, mixed stores, body/dual assessment representations, and malformed current records reject before authoritative writes.

Each supporting record has matching kind and Change identity plus explicit applicability where its selected contract requires a reliance declaration. A physical registry is adapter-owned bookkeeping; an extra physical file contributes no authority.

Every typed reference resolves exactly one field-compatible object within the same complete candidate and declared identity namespace. Missing, ambiguous, wrong-kind, or cross-Change fallback targets reject.
Related typed references may resolve to entries explicitly introduced by the same task in its complete candidate; intermediate construction grants no workflow authority.

Review and Verification assessments preserve their explicit scope, governing basis, support and limitations; incomplete shapes reject, while missing success prerequisites do not prohibit a truthful adverse assessment.
Preview, execution and staged maintenance use the same current candidate invariants. Validation grants neither engineering approval nor external execution authority.

sources.basis: Derive this draft lower-level obligation from the containing SR at the selected command or operational-record responsibility boundary. Allocation and acceptance criteria are design claims for review, not implementation, requirement approval, or satisfaction evidence.
